{{Quote|Poe, I'm picking up some sort of signal. It's faint, but I think it's coming from that moon up ahead.|Kazuda Xiono, to Poe Dameron|<ref name="The Core Problem" />}}
A '''moon''' was located in the [[Dassal system]] in the [[Unknown Regions]], [[orbit]]ing the [[planetoid]] [[Najra-Va]], which had been cored out by the [[First Order]]. Due to the disappearance of the [[Star system|system's]] [[Dassal system's sun|sun]], the moon's surface was rocky and [[Temperature|cold]]. A [[Unidentified village (Dassal system)|village]] was located on the moon, but its inhabitants had been [[Death|massacred]]. When [[Mission to the Dassal system|investigating]] the system, [[Poe Dameron]] and [[Kazuda Xiono]] landed on the [[moon]], encountering a [[spider probe droid]].<ref name="The Core Problem" />
